ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The opening Church Slavonic «Довлеет дневи злоба его» (Dovleet dnevi zloba ego, Matthew 6:34) is rendered literally in a slightly archaic register, 'Sufficient unto the day is its evil', as the project does for Slavonic quotations. Tolstoy's italics (*future* life, *there in nowhere*) and the contrast «будущая»/«настоящая» жизнь (budushchaya/nastoyashchaya zhizn', 'future'/'present' life) are kept.
Source observation: [7] this paragraph, from the same Emerson source, is printed after the attribution «Эмерсон.» and outside the quotation; translated as printed
